content.short: Nomis assigns Reputation Scores to wallets based on onchain activity.
content.description: Nomis creates Reputation Scores for wallets based on on-chain activity, acting as a dedicated layer for Web3 personalization. It enables the creation and evolution of on-chain reputations that resemble real-world identities, and it provides a scoring infrastructure—including an API and SubGraph—to offer terms, incentives, rates, and powers to builders. By applying business-oriented scoring models, Nomis enhances utility and personalizes Web3 experiences, helping projects tailor access and rewards to users with greater precision.
